newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer as NYMEX rebounds on gasoline.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer as NYMEX rebounds on gasoline.

text.p: September Brent futures were quoted mostly higher on SIMEX on Tuesday, boosted by the NYMEX complex which gained on a firmer gasoline market.
In after hours ACCESS trading, August gasoline was last traded at 65.50 cents per gallon, 0.66 higher than in New York.
New York gasoline gained 0.81, partly amid option expiry trading to hit the strike value of 65.
Earlier, ACCESS traders said the options-related play sparked healthy ACCESS volume of more than 500 lots, in line with a similar number of exercised options.
The firm tone support NYMEX September crude, which was last traded on ACCESS at $19.87, up six cents from New York.
Crude futures fell in London and New York overnight as Iraq put into place the last plank of its aid distribution plan, bringing oil exports one step closer.
But the firm gasoline market limited the downside.
September Brent crude on SIMEX was quoted around midday at $18.40/$18.55 per barrel, on the upside of London's settlement of $18.41.
